infoYearT1.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/11] Participants were members of the Christchurch Health and Development Study (CHDS) birth cohort. The CHDS is a longitudinal study of 1265 children born in the Christchurch (New Zealand) urban region over a 4-month period during 1977. This cohort has been studied at regular intervals from birth until age 35 years (Fergusson & Horwood, 2001, 2013).
